name: Kuzuhara Mai
source:
Although she isn't biologically related to Yuuichi, She and her twin sister are deeply attached to him, and lovingly call him "Big Brother".

The two had been spying on Mikiko as she was trained by Yuuichi. The two of them also share a secret.

They regularly caress one another night after night, and once Yuuichi found out about it, they ended up being trained by him.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ002522.html]DLsite[/url]]
